attributes.action: Require the use of renewable energy only to power the national grid
attributes.additional_details: We could dramatically change our country by ensuring that the electricity coming into our homes, workplaces, and everywhere else in our country only comes from renewable energy, rather than a mix that includes fossil fuels. This change could significantly impact climate change in the UK as by not using fossil fuels to generate electricity, we could significantly reduce carbon emissions and slow down climate change, which we believe is absolutely vital.
attributes.background: Require the sole use of renewable energy sources to power the national electricity grid so that 100% of electricity generated in the national grid is from renewable energy sources.

departments.name: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
